title.narrative: Rehabilitation of homes and schools damaged by torrents and floods in Al-Manaqil locality, Al-Jazira State, Republic of Sudan

description.narrative: Increasing access to safe and healthy housing for those affected by torrents and floods, and restoring basic educational services in the region for 3,038 beneficiaries.
Rebuilding 112 housing units for families that lost permanent shelter during the fall floods of 2022, and rebuilding the primary and middle school in the village of Abu Hajab.

Restoring permanent shelter for fragile and vulnerable groups affected by natural disasters, and restoring educational buildings damaged by torrents and floods in the village of Abu Hajab - Gezira State in the Republic of Sudan.
